Transport Documents

Thông báo quá cảnh

A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

Quick answer: A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

Quick answer

A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

Why it matters

Thông báo quá cảnh matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Thông báo quá cảnh?

In this glossary, Thông báo quá cảnh refers to: A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

How is Thông báo quá cảnh used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Thông báo quá cảnh phải được gửi đến tất cả các bên khi hàng hóa vượt biên giới quốc tế hoặc thay đổi phương thức vận chuyển."

Why does Thông báo quá cảnh matter in logistics?

Thông báo quá cảnh matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Thông báo quá cảnh?

Thông báo quá cảnh is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Thông báo quá cảnh belong to?

In this glossary, Thông báo quá cảnh is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A formal notification issued by the carrier or freight forwarder informing stakeholders of the progress, movement, or arrival of goods in transit between locations.

Operational example

Transit Advice must be issued to all parties when the cargo crosses international borders or changes transport mode.

Localized term
